# Staples
> Staples is an online retailer for office supplies, furniture, technology, print services, and business essentials with fast delivery options.

Staples serves businesses, schools, and consumers with a broad catalog of workplace products, custom printing, ink and toner, cleaning and breakroom supplies, and business purchasing programs. The site also includes account services, rewards, subscriptions, and category-specific shopping hubs.

## Shop by Category
- [Office Supplies](https://www.staples.com/Office-Supplies/cat_CL140420): Pens, paper, notebooks, filing, desk accessories, and everyday workplace essentials.
- [Furniture](https://www.staples.com/Furniture/cat_CL166253): Office chairs, desks, storage, lighting, and workspace furniture for home or business.
- [Computers & Accessories](https://www.staples.com/Computers-Accessories/cat_CL167289): Laptops, monitors, keyboards, mice, docking stations, and computer peripherals.
- [Printers, Ink & Toner](https://www.staples.com/Printers-Ink-Toner/cat_CL167290): Printers, replacement ink, toner cartridges, and printing-related supplies.
- [Paper](https://www.staples.com/Paper/cat_CL140421): Copy paper, specialty paper, photo paper, and mailing and brochure stock.
- [Cleaning & Breakroom](https://www.staples.com/Cleaning-Breakroom/cat_CL142744): Cleaning products, janitorial supplies, coffee, snacks, and breakroom essentials.
- [School Supplies](https://www.staples.com/School-Supplies/cat_CL167017): Classroom and student supplies, backpacks, writing tools, and organization products.
- [Packing & Shipping Supplies](https://www.staples.com/Packing-Shipping-Supplies/cat_CL140422): Boxes, mailers, tape, labels, bubble wrap, and shipping materials.

## Printing & Marketing Services
- [Print & Marketing Services](https://www.staples.com/services/printing/): Hub for document printing, signs, banners, marketing materials, and custom products.
- [Business Cards](https://www.staples.com/services/printing/business-cards/): Custom business card printing with multiple paper stocks, finishes, and design options.
- [Flyers](https://www.staples.com/services/printing/flyers/): Custom flyer printing for promotions, events, menus, and informational handouts.
- [Brochures](https://www.staples.com/services/printing/brochures/): Folded brochure printing for marketing, product information, and business communications.
- [Posters](https://www.staples.com/services/printing/posters/): Large-format poster printing for presentations, events, and in-store signage.
- [Banners](https://www.staples.com/services/printing/banners/): Indoor and outdoor banner printing for promotions, trade shows, and events.
- [Signs & Posters](https://www.staples.com/services/printing/signs-posters/): Printed signage products for retail, office, event, and directional use cases.
- [Promotional Products](https://www.staples.com/services/printing/promotional-products/): Branded merchandise and giveaway items for marketing and business outreach.

## Deals, Rewards & Programs
- [Deals](https://www.staples.com/deals): Current promotions, discounts, featured offers, and limited-time savings across categories.
- [Coupons](https://www.staples.com/coupons): Available coupon offers and promotional savings for qualifying purchases.
- [Easy Rewards](https://www.staples.com/easyrewards): Staples loyalty program with member benefits, points, and account-linked offers.
- [AutoRestock](https://www.staples.com/sbd/cre/marketing/auto-restock/): Subscription-style replenishment program for recurring office supply purchases.
- [Business Advantage](https://www.staples.com/businessadvantage/home): Business purchasing program with account tools, pricing, and procurement support.
- [Classroom Rewards](https://www.staples.com/classroomrewards): Education-focused rewards program supporting teachers and classroom purchases.

## Customer Account & Support
- [My Account](https://www.staples.com/account): Account access for orders, saved items, payment methods, and preferences.
- [Orders](https://www.staples.com/account/orders): Order history and tracking for recent and past Staples purchases.
- [Help Center](https://www.staples.com/sbd/cre/help-center/): Customer support hub for orders, returns, delivery, and account questions.
- [Returns](https://www.staples.com/sbd/cre/help-center/returns): Information about return eligibility, process, and refund handling.
- [Shipping](https://www.staples.com/sbd/cre/help-center/shipping): Delivery options, timing, thresholds, and shipping policy details.
- [Contact Us](https://www.staples.com/sbd/cre/help-center/contact-us): Customer service contact options for support and issue resolution.
- [Store Locator](https://stores.staples.com/): Find Staples retail store locations, hours, and in-store services.

## Services & Specialty Programs
- [Staples Business](https://www.staples.com/business): Business-focused shopping, procurement, and workplace supply solutions.
- [Promotional Products](https://www.staplespromotionalproducts.com/): Custom branded merchandise and promotional item ordering for organizations.
- [Travel Services](https://www.staples.com/stores/services/travel): Travel-related in-store services and program information where available.
- [Passport Photos](https://www.staples.com/stores/services/passport-photos): In-store passport photo service information and participating location details.
- [Computer Repair Services](https://www.staples.com/stores/services/computer-repair): Tech support and repair services for computers and related devices.
- [Recycling Services](https://www.staples.com/stores/recycling): Recycling program information for ink, electronics, batteries, and other materials.
